name: Necron Immortals (Gauss Blaster Squad)

loreStats.armorComposition: Reinforced Heavy Necrodermis Carapace with Quantum Shielding Inlays
loreStats.citation: Codex: Necrons (9th Ed), Robert Rath - The Infinite and the Divine (2020)
loreStats.loreSummary: Veterans of the War in Heaven retain strategic tactical sentience. Armored in heavy necrodermis capable of withstanding direct anti-tank fire while returning hyper-accelerated gauss volleys.

tacticalDescription: Heavy frontline fire-support cadre. Heavy armor mitigation and devastating anti-infantry armor-piercing firepower.
